implementation_strategy: Execute preregistered paired confirmatory run (N=300) using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter and the gpt-5-mini hosted model. For each preregistered task index (deterministic challenging_workflow_stress_v1 profile) produce one shared initial generation (baseline) and one GVR execution (guarded) following the adapter's shared_initial_candidate semantics. Deterministic verifiers (Batfish + secondary automated checker) perform autonomous scoring; if verifier fails, perform at most one automated repair call per task. All model calls, verifier logs, retries, exclusions, and hashes recorded.
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic generation of 300 intents from public NetConfEval-like examples and seeded synthetic generator; select task indices exactly from challenging_workflow_stress_v1 profile (8-cycle offsets [4,5,6,7,8]).
transformation_manifest_strategy: Use adapter-declared deterministic CLI normalization and template-based repair-prompt mapping; unit-tested templates and semantic-equivalence checks.
randomisation_plan: Task indices fixed by adapter's deterministic challenging_workflow_stress_v1 rule; no post-hoc randomisation.
caching_plan: Cache verifier results and normalized configs locally; cache model prompts/contexts only for reproducibility hashes; cache does not change execution logic.
failure_recovery_plan: Per preregistration retry policy: up to 2 automatic retries for transient LLM/API failures (within adapter max attempts). If retries exhausted, mark pair per missingness_plan and apply complete_pair_primary/exclusion rules. Verifier crashes logged and retried; if persistent, follow missingness_plan and log.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (version 1.0) as declared by adapter: per-pair baseline initial output, guarded GVR final output, verifier pass/fail flags, repair iteration count, end-to-end latency (s), provenance flags.
estimated_compute_notes: Estimated model calls = 300 tasks * expected 1.5 calls/task ≈ 450 calls (within adapter max of 600). Use hosted API (no local GPU). Wall-clock budget within 7 days.
